items.title: How much will it cost?
items.detail: Add rent, food, insurance and travel to tuition. Make a budget for the full year.

items.title: What about safety?
items.detail: Talk to seniors about the city, campus and housing. Listen to real experiences.

items.title: Where will the money come from?
items.detail: Savings, scholarships and education loans. Understand all three options first.

items.title: What after the degree?
items.detail: Check the course's career outcomes and that country's post-study work rules first.
